text: Optimove to cut 10% of jobs in AI push Marketing services provider’s CEO Pini Yakuel labels decision “painful” to make but says it is steeped in a push for innovation. June 17, 2026 Share this by Jonny Whitfield AI The CEO of igaming marketing services provider Optimove, Pini Yakuel, has revealed the “painful” decision to cut 10 per cent of his staff in a push towards AI. Yakuel said he wants to make Optimove “faster, sharper, and even more innovative.” “You will see us lead with AI not only in our product, but also in the way we operate, support you and help you navigate your own challenges and opportunities in this new era,” he added on LinkedIn. Optimove to offer AI training The CEO and founder said those unaffected by the layoffs will be given training in AI to “shape the next version of this company.” He said he made the decision while Optimove is “financially healthy” and has a wide-ranging client base. “To the people leaving Optimove: thank you. You helped shape this company. We are grateful for what you gave, and we will do our best to support you through this transition,” he concluded. Optimove joins Gambling.com Group and Bragg Gaming Group in cutting jobs to support the growth of AI. Affiliate Gambling.com Group revealed in May that 25 per cent of jobs are being cut , while igaming supplier bragg is cutting over a tenth of its workforce . Recent Optimove partners have included EGT Digital and EveryMatrix . Optimove acquires Smartico to beef up CRM capability The layoffs come after Optimove acquired CRM provider Smartico , with the deal announced in April. Both companies are continuing to operate fully independently, with the Smartico founders continuing in their posts. “What impressed us about Smartico is the combination of product strength, service excellence and the way the company has been built,” said Yakuel.
